text:
maya: Quick heads-up — yesterday's late-night int4 rollout showed a small but consistent degradation on the conversational QA eval for a narrow query slice. I want to add a "precision circuit breaker" flag that auto-falls back to fp16 for affected customers/audiences. thoughts?

sam: Do we mean auto-fallback per-customer or global per-model?

maya: Per-customer (tenant-level) first, with a global kill-switch. Goal: minimize blast radius. Canary stays int4, but affected tenants flip to fp16.

olivia: Sounds good. What are the guardrails for triggering the circuit breaker?

maya: Provisional rules: 1) NLG quality drop > 3% on our conv-eval (window 30m) OR 2) user-visible error rate increase > 0.5% OR 3) latency p50 jump > 200ms sustained for 5m. Manual override always allowed.

leo: Can we keep canary at 1% or do we need 2% to catch things?

maya: Keep canary at 1% for latency-sensitive flows, 2% for exploratory chat. We'll run the 2% for 2 hours then revert to 1% if stable.

sam: Who's on flip duty if the circuit breaker fires unexpectedly? I can take midnight-3am shift tomorrow.

maya: Awesome — tagging you as primary. olivia backup.

olivia: What's the exact command and the config path? Put it in runbook so eng-oncall can find it.

maya: command in infra toolbox:
```
redwoodctl flags set --name precision_cb --tenant <TENANT_ID> --value fp16 --reason "auto-fallback: convqa-regression"
```
Global kill: `redwoodctl flags set --name precision_cb --value global-fp16`

maya: Runbook link (draft): https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/precision-circuit-breaker — includes playbook, dashboards, and rollback steps.

infra-bot: Canary deployment to model-oz-3 started at 1912345690. Canary: 2% chat, 1% llm-api. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/oz-canary-1912345690

leo: Can we add an extra metric for hallucination rate (QA false positives)? Last time that flagged earlier than BLEU.

maya: Yes good call — add "halluc_rate" with threshold 1.5% in guardrails.

olivia: Also add an auto-latency-escape rule: if p95 > 600ms for 3m, auto-fallback. We should avoid noisy flaps — add 3 occurrences in 15m window as final condition.

maya: Agreed. I'll update the runbook and add those thresholds.

sam: Leaving a quick checklist for flip: 1) confirm metric pipeline healthy 2) sanity eval on sample prompts 3) announce in #eng-oncall 4) execute command 5) monitor 15m -> escalate if needed.

maya: Perfect. I'll push the runbook update and a small PR to add the flag wiring (will ping for review).

sam: :thumbsup: I can review the PR tonight after 7pm PT.

infra-bot: Alert config snippet created: `metric: convqa_bleu, window: 30m, threshold: -3% -> action: precision_cb_fallback`

olivia: Putting the playbook in a pinned thread on eng-oncall and adding a short runthrough doc for SRE on-call.

maya: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge PR, run canary for 2h tomorrow morning, sam on-call overnight, olivia backstop. Will post final timings here once CI passes.

sam: noted.

leo: Thanks — good to have a clear escape hatch.

maya: end of thread: will update with PR link and final canary time.
